Data Engineer I

Job ID: 10610327 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now
Description

Are you passionate about building data pipelines and turning raw information into actionable insights? Do you enjoy designing solutions that help teams make smarter, faster decisions? As a Data Engineer I at Amazon, you will build and maintain data solutions that power critical business decisions across the organization. You will work with large-scale datasets, design efficient data models, and create automated pipelines that process millions of data points. This is an opportunity to grow your technical skills while collaborating with analysts, data scientists, and engineers who rely on your work to unlock the value hidden in data. If you are curious, resourceful, and energized by solving real problems with data, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL workflows that ingest, transform, and persist data from multiple sources at scale.
- Create and optimize physical data models, applying best practices in schema design, partitioning, indexing, and query performance tuning to ensure reliable and efficient data access.
- Write secure, testable, and well-documented code using scripting and query languages such as SQL, Python, or Scala to automate data processing and support analytical workloads.
- Collaborate with business analysts, data scientists, and engineering partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet business needs.
- Monitor data pipelines for operational issues, troubleshoot root causes, and resolve defects to maintain data integrity and system reliability.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing pipeline health dashboards and addressing any data quality alerts. From there, you might refine a data model to support a new reporting requirement, write and test ETL code, or pair with a teammate to review a schema change. Expect regular conversations with analysts and data scientists who depend on your pipelines, helping you stay connected to the business impact of your work. You will also participate in design discussions and code reviews, continuously sharpening your skills in a collaborative engineering environment.

About the team
Amazon's Global Logistics (GL) Exports team supports Amazon's vision of offering customers worldwide cross-border product selection at competitive prices. We build the data infrastructure and analytics that power smart, data-driven decisions for customers, sellers, and vendors navigating international trade and logistics. Our work directly shapes Amazon's ability to scale globally and deliver innovative e-commerce solutions.

We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. You'll join a group of engineers who support each other through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback. We're investing in scalable, well-architected data solutions, and we're excited to welcome team members who want to grow their careers while making a meaningful impact on how Amazon uses data to connect the world.

Basic Qualifications

- 1+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
- Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)
- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
- Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.
